title: Fixed-Threshold One-Bit Toeplitz Covariance Estimation under Sparse-Ruler Sampling
summary: We estimate the Toeplitz covariance matrix of a centered Gaussian distribution from data that are both coarsely quantized and sparsely sampled. Only the coordinates of a sparse ruler are recorded, and each recorded value is kept as a single bit: the sign of its comparison with a fixed threshold. Such data arise in low-precision sensing front ends and sparse sensor arrays. Because the threshold is nonzero, every bit has a common mean.
